changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_savings_product SET product_category = 'GOAL' WHERE product_category IS NULL AND deposit_type_enum = 100 AND LOWER(TRIM(name)) IN ('goal savings', 'goalsave', 'goal save') AND (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM m_savings_product g WHERE g.deposit_type_enum = 100 AND LOWER(TRIM(g.name)) IN ('goal savings', 'goalsave', 'goal save')) = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_savings_product x WHERE x.product_category = 'GOAL'); UPDATE m_savings_product SET product_category = 'AUTOSAVE' WHERE product_category IS NULL AND deposit_type_enum = 100 AND LOWER(TRIM(name)) IN ('autosave', 'auto save') AND (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM m_savings_product a WHERE a.deposit_type_enum = 100 AND LOWER(TRIM(a.name)) IN ('autosave', 'auto save')) = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_savings_product x WHERE x.product_category = 'AUTOSAVE'); UPDATE m_savings_product SET product_category = 'DIGITAL' WHERE product_category IS NULL AND deposit_type_enum = 100 AND LOWER(TRIM(name)) IN ('savings', 'personal savings', 'standard savings', 'regular savings', 'kobi digital savings');

changeSet.author: fiteraccess
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_m_savings_product_single_category ON m_savings_product (product_category) WHERE product_category IN ('GOAL', 'AUTOSAVE');
